name: Khee San Berhad
overview: 2026年，Khee San Berhad 完成了正则化计划（包括债务重组安排、股本削减和员工持股计划），并与马来西亚杂货商联合会及 Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam 签署谅解备忘录，拟为 FSGMAM 会员推行零售数字化与转型计划。公司未公告产能扩张、新业务线或业务出售事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Khee San Berhad completed its Regularisation Plan (comprising the Scheme of Arrangement, Share Capital Reduction and Employees' Share Scheme) and entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with the Federation of Sundry Goods Merchants Associations of Malaysia and Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam in relation to a proposed retail digitalisation and transformation programme for FSGMAM members. No capacity expansion, new business line or business disposal was announced.

segments.name: 零售业务
segments.note: 今年与 FSGMAM 及 Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam 签署谅解备忘录，拟为 FSGMAM 会员推行零售数字化与转型计划。
segments.note_en: This year, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with FSGMAM and Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam in relation to a proposed retail digitalisation and transformation programme for FSGMAM members.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 The Federation of Sundry Goods Merchants Associations of Malaysia (FSGMAM) 及 Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam 签署谅解备忘录，涉及为 FSGMAM 会员推行的零售数字化与转型计划。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with The Federation of Sundry Goods Merchants Associations of Malaysia (FSGMAM) and Dr Paul Lim Pang Kiam in relation to the proposed retail digitalisation and transformation programme for FSGMAM members.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成正则化计划，包括债务重组安排、股本削减及员工持股计划。
segments.note_en: This year completed the Regularisation Plan, comprising the Scheme of Arrangement, Share Capital Reduction and Employees' Share Scheme.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 员工持股计划于2026年3月17日生效，正则化计划随之完成。
actions.text_en: The Employees' Share Scheme became effective on 17 March 2026, and the Regularisation Plan was completed following that effective date.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 债务重组安排（Scheme of Arrangement）已完成全部结算及义务。
actions.text_en: The Scheme of Arrangement was completed with full settlement and obligations fulfilled.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 于2026年2月27日批准将正则化计划的实施期限延长6个月至2026年8月18日。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities on 27 February 2026 granted a further extension of time of 6 months up to 18 August 2026 to implement the Regularisation Plan.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 以符合《2016年公司法》第117(1)条的要求；正则化计划条款不变。
actions.text_en: Proposed to obtain a new shareholders' resolution for the Share Capital Reduction to comply with Section 117(1) of the Companies Act 2016; there is no variation to the terms of the Regularisation Plan.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 于2026年1月30日向 Bursa Securities 申请将正则化计划的实施期限进一步延长6个月至2026年8月18日。
actions.text_en: On 30 January 2026, submitted an application to Bursa Securities to seek a further extension of time of 6 months up to 18 August 2026 to complete the implementation of the Regularisation Plan.
